name: edu-monorepo
description: Edu AI Platform - Monorepo with Web, Mobile, and Shared packages

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
